character: Former F1 circuit built around Sochi's Olympic Park with an unusually long, constant-radius Turn 3 and mostly 90-degree corners. Tyre and brake management through the sustained long corners is the key challenge.

corners.name: Turn 2
corners.type: heavy-braking corner off the main straight
corners.trap: Over-braking and losing momentum into Turn 3

corners.name: Turn 3
corners.type: very long, 180-degree decreasing-radius left-hander (longest turn of any modern F1 circuit)
corners.technique: Patient, progressive line as the corner tightens around its full radius
corners.trap: Apexing too early leaves nowhere to go as the corner keeps tightening

corners.name: Turn 4
corners.technique: Smooth, committed steering through the long radius
corners.trap: Over-driving the entry and running out of track mid-corner

corners.name: Turn 12-13
corners.type: fast sweeping combination taken around 240 km/h
corners.technique: Minimal lift, smooth steering through the direction change
corners.trap: Any correction at this speed scrubs significant time
